title: Ben Rich and reverse-engineered aerospace

tellings.quote:

Rich a liar

plain: John Blitch, a scientist who worked with DARPA, the Pentagon's agency for advanced research projects, talks on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels about Ben Rich, an aerospace engineer. Rich's words are linked to the idea that some American aircraft technology was copied from craft of unknown origin, and Blitch says he has no reason to call Ben Rich a liar. If true, it would mean the US has studied and copied non-human technology.
